activity_summary: At nine you were still in the lodging. The almanac had the day. You did not go up to the Theatre. You did not write that the hour had failed. You wrote only that it was not you.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stayed at the table and did not go out.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Mentioned in The nine o'clock, unkept by him
